presentation.label: PLAYHEAD DIRECTION
presentation.summary: Play patterns reversed, pingpong, random or shuffled: per pattern, shared by every track or set per track.
presentation.overview: Play Modes changes which step the sequencer plays at each position: NORMAL, REVERSED, PINGPONG (end steps once), PINGPONG 2 (end steps twice), RANDOM or SHUFFLE. Each pattern keeps its own modes: one shared mode under SCALE MODE NORMAL, one per audio and MIDI track under PER TRACK. Trigs, conditions, micro-timing, swing and locks move with their step; tempo, lengths, chains and the trig LEDs stay in step. The modes are saved with the project, survive a power cycle and follow pattern copy, paste and clear.
highlights: Six playhead modes, including two pingpongs and a shuffle that plays every step once per pass
Per pattern; per track under PER TRACK scale mode, audio and MIDI tracks
Hold a TRACK key and press UP or DOWN; a popup names the mode
Saved in the project, kept over a power cycle, carried by pattern copy and paste
usage: Hold a TRACK key and press DOWN to step through NORMAL, REVERSED, PINGPONG, PINGPONG 2, RANDOM and SHUFFLE; UP walks back. The popup shows ALL <mode> under SCALE MODE NORMAL, or T1..T8 / M1..M8 <mode> under PER TRACK.
Each pattern keeps its own modes; PLAY and every pattern change start the tracks from their first step again.
Under PER TRACK, MASTER LENGTH limits how far a track gets; set it to INF to let every track run its full length in every mode.

access.location: Automatic when included in a build: hold a TRACK key on the main screen and press UP or DOWN.
steps: Include Play Modes in your build. It uses no effect slot and no knob.
Load a pattern and choose its SCALE MODE in PATTERN SETTINGS: NORMAL for one shared mode, PER TRACK for one mode per track.
Hold TRACK 1 (or the track to change) and press DOWN or UP; the popup shows the new mode. Press PLAY.
Hold the TRACK key and press UP until the popup shows NORMAL to return to stock playback.

limitations: Does not combine with octabam's PLOCKS P2 (not in this catalog): both use battery RAM 0x100f8600.. and the 20 pattern-copy memcpy sites.
Deliberate stock-flow change: TRACK held + UP / DOWN changes the mode and does not reach the stock arrow handler; project.work gains #PLAY_MODES= comment lines.
Copying a single track does not copy its mode; PROJECT > NEW may keep the previous project's modes (untested).
Played interactively on one MKII (builds 12-19); MKI, micro-timing, trig conditions, slides, live recording and MIDI tracks beyond a first check are untested.
Chip worst-case cycles are unmeasured; no stress project has been run.
Like every DRAM module, the build gives up about 10 MB of sample memory to the platform reserve.

storage.label: DRAM data + battery RAM
storage.display: 4,684 B DRAM data + 2,310 B battery RAM, plus code
storage.conditions: Data allocations of hooks.s and the battery-RAM table; the code size of playmodes.s comes from the build report and is not yet recorded. See TESTING.md Resources.

processing.label: ColdFire processing
processing.conditions: One engine call per track per sequencer step, plus the UI step query and the rebuild after edits; not measured on the chip.

impact.conditions: 16 tracks (8 audio, 8 MIDI) in SHUFFLE, the most expensive mode, at the highest tempo and finest track scale; a project load rewriting the battery table.

cpu.rationale: Per track per step a few byte reads, one pass test and one mapping; SHUFFLE adds a keyed permutation (about two evaluations, three multiplies each). Battery-RAM writes only on key presses, pattern copies and project loads.

dsp.rationale: No DSP code, tables or buffers; stock DSP processing is unchanged.

memory.rationale: About 4.7 KB of DRAM data in the platform reserve plus the unit's code, and a 2,310-byte battery-RAM table; no per-instance copies.

tests.summary: Host suites for the engine and firmware glue pass (every mode for lengths 1-64, look-ahead, restarts, per-pattern rows, project lines, battery RAM, copy / paste / clear). Played interactively on the author's MKII over test builds 12-19; no stress project, no chip timing, no UI captures yet.
